My journey began by being hurled upwards in some sort of new space pod the company has been working on. I started out being suspicious of whether or not this new technology would actually work, but I was in for a surprise it seemed.The acceleration on this thing has broken the limits on what was possible for Earthly inventions in the past. In fact, I still can't believe it. Within milliseconds I was in space. This is about the time the speed picks up and all of the little ant-sized forests and cities quickly morph into infinite geometric patterns cascading over one another. What came next seems to be an instantenous feeling of a godlike presence. I look around and all I can see are neon shapes and patterns all in the foreground of a beautiful blackness which contains all our universe. Actually logic is starting to fade now. It is entirely possibly I have opened the metaphorical door. Or is it even a metaphor? Did I actually cross over? And into what realm, if I did?

Regardless the ominous presence of something mystical remains while I am suspened here in this (now damaged) space craft. I attempt to move forward in hopes of finding any clue as to what is happening. Finally I removed myself from these clutches that held me to move forward. I know something is very wrong when I feel the force of the strongest winds blowing up past my face. Suddenly I realize I am falling and fast. All the stars begin to dissapear and the cities reappear in a blink of an eye...

...I awake to find myself sitting with legs crossed on my bed. The pipe I am hold seems to have a very strange residue inside. Was it all a dream?
